title: NYUAD at ArGuard Shared Tasks: Multimodal Embedding Models for Detecting Arabic Hateful Memes and Unsafe Prompts
abstract: arXiv:2611.18608v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid growth of social media and generative AI has significantly increased the volume of Arabic textual content, memes, and user prompts shared across online platforms. While these media facilitate communication, creativity, and information exchange, they can also be exploited to disseminate hate speech, harmful content, and unsafe instructions. As a result, there is an increasing need for reliable automated methods to identify hateful Arabic memes and harmful (unsafe) prompts. This paper leverages pre-trained and fine-tuned multilingual embedding models to learn rich semantic representations from textual and visual content. The evaluation is conducted using a dataset of Arabic memes and prompts proposed in the ArabicNLP ArGuard 2026 challenge. The results underscore the capacity of large language model (LLM)-based embedding models to deliver superior performance. Developing robust detection systems is essential for improving content

translated_title: 纽约大学阿布扎比分校参加ArGuard共享任务：用于检测阿拉伯语仇恨模因和不安全提示的多模态嵌入模型
translated_abstract: 社交媒体和生成式人工智能的快速发展显著增加了在线平台上分享的阿拉伯语文本内容、模因和用户提示的数量。虽然这些媒介促进了交流、创造力和信息交换，但它们也可能被利用来传播仇恨言论、有害内容和不安全指令。因此，人们对可靠的自动化方法来识别仇恨阿拉伯语模因和有害（不安全）提示的需求日益增长。本文利用预训练和微调的多语言嵌入模型，从文本和视觉内容中学习丰富的语义表示。评估是在ArabicNLP ArGuard 2026挑战赛提出的阿拉伯语模因和提示数据集上进行的。结果凸显了基于大语言模型（LLM）的嵌入模型所具备的卓越性能。开发稳健的检测系统对于改善内容（安全）至关重要。
tldr: 本文利用预训练和微调的多模态多语言嵌入模型，在ArGuard 2026挑战赛数据集上检测阿拉伯语仇恨模因和不安全提示，并证明基于大语言模型的嵌入模型具有卓越性能。
en_tdlr: This paper leverages pre-trained and fine-tuned multimodal multilingual embedding models to detect Arabic hateful memes and unsafe prompts on the ArGuard 2026 challenge dataset, demonstrating the superior performance of LLM-based embedding models.
